name: Toki Time
review:
Toki Time is a cute 11-line slot. Expanding wilds trigger a respin on a win, and wins pay both ways.

Thunderkick rates it Low volatility, with a 1,130x cap and a 97.1% RTP. Relaxed and high-returning.

The expanding wild respin and both-ways wins make for frequent small hits, helped by one of the highest RTPs on the market at 97.1%. Cute alpine creatures complete the picture.
pros: Excellent 97.10% RTP – among the highest published
Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
